count_definitions.duplicate_records: Valid-URL occurrences minus unique normalized URLs
count_definitions.invalid_timestamps: Includes missing_timestamps; counted over raw retrieval occurrences
count_definitions.invalid_urls: Includes missing_urls; every invalid-URL occurrence is quarantined separately
count_definitions.quality_flags: Union of issues observed in any source occurrence of the URL
count_definitions.records_by_category: Raw retrieval occurrences, including quarantined records
count_definitions.records_by_domain: Deduplicated valid-URL articles; deterministic representative metadata
count_definitions.records_by_language: Deduplicated valid-URL articles; deterministic representative metadata

timestamp_semantics: GDELT seendate is first-seen/indexed time, not verified publication time
